text:
alex.w: kicking off staged rollout v2024.09 -> prod. plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100%. change window ends 02:00 UTC. release notes https://redwood.example/release/v2024.09 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout (id: r-20240901-01). canary at 1% -> progressing to 10% in ~5m unless flagged.
sarah.m: seeing a 95p latency bump on embed-service at ~10% at 1728795450. 180ms -> ~320ms, p90 fine but spikes on p95. linking graph: https://grafana/redwood/d/embeds
jay.k: ok pause when we hit 10% then. any error surge?
sarah.m: no error rate increase, just tail latency on a subset of requests (long contexts).
deploy-bot: Reached 10% at 1728795460. continuing hold window per safety checks.
priya.r: EU traffic is overlapped with a batch job rn. i'd prefer to pin EU to v2024.08 for now and let NA continue canary.
alex.w: propose quick vote — thumbs up to continue rollout globally, thumbs down to rollback to v2024.08, :hand: to pin EU and continue elsewhere. please react or reply within 6m.
jay.k: :thumbsup: continue for NA, but pause EU.
sarah.m: :thumbsdown: rollback if tail stays high after 15m.
priya.r: :hand: pin EU to v2024.08 — i'll run the pin if consensus to split.
ops-bot: Note: change-window ends 02:00 UTC. SLA team oncall @oncall is paged for visibility.
alex.w: tally so far — 1 up (jay.k), 1 down (sarah.m), 1 hand (priya.r). no clear majority. leaning to conservative: hold global at 10% and execute region pin for eu-west.
priya.r: running pin in eu-west now. command:
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --service embed-service --from v2024.09 --to v2024.08 --reason "bakewindow overlap + p95 tail" 
```
deploy-bot: Execution queued: pin job j-88231. ETA 40s.
ops-bot: eu-west pin completed at 1728795525. traffic for eu-west now at v2024.08.
alex.w: pausing global rollout at 10% pending 30m observation. no rollback yet. ops please keep an eye on p95 and errors; if p95 stays >250ms and errors >0.5% then we rollback.
sarah.m: putting a short eval set together to check generation quality vs latency tradeoff.
jay.k: i'll watch infra queues and KV cache evictions.
priya.r: thanks — will update once pin confirmed stable.
alex.w: final note: change-window override not needed now, but tag the release with "partial-pin-eu" and update release notes. I'll follow up with an incident if we cross thresholds. :eyes:
